boxes.meaning: person who lives on an island

english.meaning: person who lives on an island
english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person who lives on an island.

examples.english: I know an islander who lives on one of the outlying islands.
examples.traditional: 我識得一個住喺離島嘅島民。
